tracked_source_findings.temporal_alignment_if_archive_is_hydrate: At each positive physics step divisible by five, the runtime reads that step's current measured positions, encodes all six tibiae, advances one neural step, and records neural telemetry at the same time. Thus neural row i should align to physics row 5*(i+1), from 0.5 through 10000.0 ms.
tracked_source_findings.neural_sensory_encoded_semantics: per-interface maximum encoded rate in LF, LM, LH, RF, RM, RH order; it is not the six physical angles
tracked_source_findings.stochastic_boundary: The angle-to-rate transformation and recorded peak are deterministic and stateless. Candidate/delivered external events involve RNG and neural refractory state and cannot be reconstructed from the six peak values alone.
